sentences.text: The May 7, 2014 circular on foreclosure charges/pre-payment penalty on floating rate term loans is not in force, because it is marked SUPERSEDED and is listed as a withdrawn circular in the 2025 consolidation.

The current in-force direction for a UCB is that, for existing floating rate term loans sanctioned before December 31, 2025 for purposes other than business to individual borrowers, the UCB shall not charge pre-payment charges.
The 2025 UCB directions also provide that, for floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges.
Because the current in-force directions cover floating rate loans and term loans, the 2014 circular has been replaced rather than remaining operative.
